meta.title: Robo Outer Space Epos
meta.author: QM
meta.description: The soundtrack of Robo Outer Space Epos by QM (2022-04-17). 32K executable music that placed 8th in the executable music competition at Revision 2022. Made with QM's own WaveSabre fork: its four Screwdriver waveshapers (fork device 13, a three-segment power curve) play here as the unified distortion's curve mode. 130 BPM, 3:23, 18 tracks, 1435 notes. Instruments: 4 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 1 Specimen (GSM sampler). Effects: 2 Leveller, 1 Echo, 1 Smasher, 1 Chamber, 3 Twister, 1 Cathedral, 4 Screwdriver. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by +0.02 dB loudness and at most 0.18 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
